title: Release risk from an overdue external dependency
tests: Dependency chains and dates. The story is blocked by an ops ticket that is waiting on a vendor and is past its due date. The model must work out the release risk from the dates against today's date, and must not invent a vendor commitment.
request: Will BANK-405 make the 3.2.0 release? What is blocking it and what should happen next?

tickets.summary: Enable mutual TLS for the partner payments API
description: Northwind Payments requires mutual TLS on all partner API calls from 1 October 2026. Our partner payments API must present and validate client certificates.
AC1. Partner API calls without a valid Northwind client certificate are rejected.
AC2. End-to-end test passes in staging against Northwind's sandbox.

comments.author: Ravi Kumar
body: Code is done and merged behind the feature flag MTLS_PARTNER (off by default). I can't run the end-to-end test until Northwind's CA certificates are in the staging trust store. That's OPS-77.

comments.author: Ravi Kumar
body: Still waiting on OPS-77. Once the certs are in staging I need about two days for the end-to-end test and fixes.

tickets.summary: Install Northwind Payments CA certificates in staging and production trust stores
description: Import the Northwind Payments CA bundle into the staging trust store first, then production. Needs the bundle from Northwind.

comments.author: Jo Tan
body: Requested the CA bundle from Northwind's integration team. They said "early next week".

comments.author: Jo Tan
body: Chased Northwind again, no reply yet. Asked our partner manager to escalate.

answer_key.expect: BANK-405 is blocked by OPS-77: the end-to-end test cannot run until Northwind's CA certificates are in the staging trust store, and OPS-77 is waiting for Northwind to send the CA bundle.
OPS-77 was due on 2026-09-10 and is overdue as of 2026-09-15; the last update (2026-09-11) says Northwind has not replied and the partner manager was asked to escalate.
Release 3.2.0 is on 2026-09-24 (sprint ends 2026-09-22), and Ravi needs about two days of end-to-end testing after the certificates arrive.
Making 3.2.0 is at serious risk / uncertain: it depends on Northwind supplying the bundle within roughly a week, and nothing in the tickets commits them to a date.
The code is complete and merged behind the MTLS_PARTNER feature flag (off by default).
The certificates are also needed in production (OPS-77 covers staging then production), and Northwind requires mTLS from 1 October 2026, so there is a hard external deadline beyond the release.

Next actions: escalate with Northwind through the partner manager (owner Jo Tan) for a firm delivery date, and plan for 3.2.0 shipping with the MTLS_PARTNER flag off if the certificates do not arrive in time.
Claims the certificates have been received or installed, or that OPS-77 is done.
answer_key.claim: Northwind has sent the CA bundle and it is installed in staging.

answer_key.expect: States a specific date by which Northwind has committed to deliver the bundle.
answer_key.claim: Northwind has committed to deliver the CA bundle by 2026-09-17.
